 Heating Assistance Available: LIHEAP Now Open to All Eligible Households Through Shawnee Development Council
 / WMOK 
 WMOK - Metropolis, IL 
 Nov 16, 2026 | 9:05 AM 
 WMOK – Metropolis, IL – As seasons shift and utility costs remain a primary concern for local households, assistance is now open for residents in Metropolis, Massac County, and neighboring areas. The Low-Income Home Energy Assistance Program (LIHEAP) is now open to all income-eligible households, with $240 million available statewide to help eligible families manage the cost of home heating and cooling bills. 
 What Is LIHEAP?
 The Low-Income Home Energy Assistance Program (LIHEAP) is a state and federally funded program designed to assist income-eligible households with energy costs. The program provides direct financial assistance toward utility bills, helping ensure that families, seniors, and individuals across southern Illinois can maintain safe and reliable power and heat in their homes.
 Important Dates and Appointments
 General enrollment opened November 1, 2026 . All income-eligible households can now apply. The application period runs through August 13, 2027 , or until funding is exhausted.
 Because funding and appointment slots fill quickly, local administrators encourage residents seeking assistance to prepare early and reach out promptly.
 Ameren Illinois Discounts for LIHEAP Households
 Households approved for LIHEAP also qualify for additional help from Ameren Illinois. Ameren Illinois offers income-tiered discounts on natural gas service charges, ranging from 5% to 84% depending on household income and family size, and customers receiving LIHEAP benefits are automatically approved for the natural gas discount. Ameren Illinois also offers an Electric Service Discount that sets a more manageable monthly payment based on household size, income and electric heating source. Under the state’s Power Bill Discount program, an Ameren Illinois electric customer can receive a discounted bill if the estimated annual electric bill is greater than 3% of the household’s income.
 How to Apply & Get More Information
 Local administration for LIHEAP is handled through Shawnee Development Council, Inc. Residents can also apply online through Help Illinois Families at helpillinoisfamilies.com by submitting a Request for Services form, or call the Help Illinois Families Call Center at 1-833-711-0374 for assistance. Community members are encouraged to contact their local office to learn more about eligibility guidelines, required documentation, and the application process.
 Massac County Office: 1 Superman Square, Metropolis, IL 
 Phone: (618) 524-2941
 Folks are encouraged to pass this information along to neighbors, family, and friends who may benefit from utility assistance as cooler weather approaches.
